content:
lina: Quick flag — HelioMaps got billed at a higher reserved tier on INV-2026-045; they signed a mid-quarter amendment to reduce from Reserved-XL to Reserved-L but our billing still applied XL for Apr. They’re asking for a correction and any SLA/burst credits. Can finance triage?
ben: Ugh, thanks for the ping. Do we have the amendment doc or PO number? Need to confirm effective date before we touch invoices.
lina: I’ve got the signed amendment PDF (HelioMaps_AMEND_0426.pdf). Effective date is 2026-04-01 per the footer. Uploading to the shared drive now.
ops-bot: Metering report for customer helio-prod (cust_8932) generated. Summary (Apr 01–30):
```
2026-04-01,committed_units,burst_units
2026-04-01,1200000,300000
2026-04-15,1200000,450000
2026-04-30,1200000,250000
TOTAL,1200000,1000000
```
sarah: Looking at the invoice lines — billing system applied Reserved-XL rate code RSRV-XL-2025 for the whole month. If amendment effective 04-01 reduced to RSRV-L-2026 we should prorate and issue a credit for the delta plus any agreed burst forgiveness.
mike: FYI I verbally promised them a one-time goodwill burst offset equal to 500k tokens when we closed the amendment (to account for their migration spikes). Should be in the deal notes.
julie: I can pull the deal notes and attach. @mike can you confirm the burst offset exactly 500k and that it's non-recurring?
mike: Confirmed — 500k one-time offset, non-recurring, no SLA credit promised beyond that.
ben: OK. Two actions: 1) Confirm billed amount and compute delta for reserved SKU difference, prorated for Apr. 2) Apply a credit memo covering (delta_proration + 500k burst at overage rate) and mark invoice as reissued. @sarah can you draft credit memo once I hand off numbers?
sarah: Yep. I’ll need the original invoice line amounts and applicable unit rates for XL vs L. Also need approval code from finance manager for > $5k credits.
lina: I pasted invoice lines here: 
```
INV-2026-045
Line 1: RSRV-XL-2025, quantity 1, period 2026-04-01 - 2026-04-30, amount $18,000
Line 2: OVG-TOK, 1,000,000 tokens, amount $4,500
Total $22,500
```
ben: From pricing sheet: RSRV-XL = $18k/month, RSRV-L = $11k/month. Delta for April = $7k. Proration is full month since amendment effective 04-01. Burst offset 500k at overage rate ($0.0045/token) = $2,250. So suggested credit = $7,000 + $2,250 = $9,250.
julie: Noted. @sarah please prepare CM for $9,250 and set accounting reason to "Contract amendment proration + goodwill burst offset".
sarah: Drafted credit memo CM-2026-011 for $9,250. Posting to AR pending manager approval. Approver tag: finance_mgmt.
ben: I'll send the approver note with contract link and ops metering snippet. Also let's include an SLA review: because burst was within 24h spike window, do we owe SLA credit beyond the goodwill? ops-bot, any SLA breach alerts for helio-prod in Apr?
ops-bot: SLA checks: No SLO breach events logged for helio-prod in April. 95th latency and availability within targets. No auto SLA credit triggered.
mike: Since I already promised the 500k offset as goodwill, we good. No further SLA credits needed per my convo with customer.
lina: Customer asked for a reissued invoice with the credit applied and a short explanation email. Who will send the communication?
julie: I can draft the email and loop AM + CS. Will attach CM and revised invoice.
sarah: Manager approved CM-2026-011 (approval id FIN-APP-7843). Credit applied in AR and refund note created. Please confirm the revised invoice number to reference.
ben: Reissued invoice created as INV-2026-045-R1 reflecting the credit. Marking original as superseded.
lina: Thanks team — I’ll notify HelioMaps and ask them to confirm receipt. :thumbsup:
mike: Great, thanks everyone. Let's log this in the customer billing issue tracker for audit.
sarah: Logged under BILL-2026-342 and attached CM/INV-R1. Closing thread once customer confirms.
lina: Closing when HelioMaps acknowledges.
